title: one round of plan review (a row of plan-review.jsonl)
description: Append-only, one row per review round, under .dabbler/runs/<set>/s<N>/plan-review.jsonl. Written only through ai_router.plan_review. Each row binds to the exact plan content it judged via plan_core_hash, so a round can never be read as evidence about a plan it did not see. The free mechanical checks run before any model and can settle a round on their own; model_called says whether this round spent anything.

schema_version.description: Frozen at v1. A reader that finds any other value refuses the record rather than interpreting it.

plan_core_hash.description: sha256:<hex> over the plan's core content (approved_plan.compute_plan_hash), which is defined before approval as well as after -- a review round happens while the plan is still rewritable, so it cannot bind to plan_hash.

outcome.description: 'bounced': the revision did not touch the fields the previous round objected to, so it was refused without a model call.

model_called.description: False when the free checks or the anti-grind bounce settled the round. The free checks run first precisely so this can be false.

free_findings.description: Findings from the mechanical checks that cost nothing. Non-empty means no model was called this round.

step_verdicts.description: One entry per step the reviewer answered. Empty when no model was called.

escalation_triggers.description: Which trigger routed this round to the premium model. Empty means the cheap reviewer was used. Recorded as a list because both triggers can fire at once and a precedence rule would hide one of them.

reviewed_steps.description: The steps this round judged, when it judged only some of them -- an amendment re-checks the step it changes and nothing else. Absent means the round covered the whole plan.

reviewer.description: Null when no model was called.

objected_field_digests.description: step_id -> field -> sha256 of that field's value as this round saw it. The next round recomputes these to decide whether a revision actually touched what was objected to, which is what makes the anti-grind bounce free.
